tenderSchedule.title: Request for Proposal (RFP) for Selection of Service Provider for Scanning and Digitization of Files and Records at the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms
tenderSchedule.description: Request for Proposal (RFP) for Selection of Service Provider for Scanning and Digitization of Files and Records at the Department of Personnel and Administrative Reforms
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited First Floor, No 59, Kumara Park West Extension, Railway Parallel Road, Seshadripuram, Bangalore 560020

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be a Firm or Company registered in India. Joint Ventures and Consortiums are not allowed
Applicant should have been in existence for a period of at least three (3) years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration / Certificate of Incorporation / LLP Registration / Partnership Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should be registered with the Commercial Tax Department for GST. Should have filed the GST Returns.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Returns for the financial year FY 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be registered with Income Tax Department and should have filed the Income Tax Returns for the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Income Tax Returns for the preceding three financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have an average annual turnover not less than Rs. 20 lakhs during the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number.
Others -- Audited Balance Sheet and Audited Profit & Loss Statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have positive net worth during any one of the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should have executed at least one (1) project of value not less than Rs. 20 lakhs in the area of scanning and digitization for Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding three (3) financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- End User Certificate / Work Completion certificate / Satisfactory Performance Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have office in Bengaluru, Karnataka If the Applicant does not have an office in Bengaluru, the Applicant should submit an undertaking stating that they shall open an office in Bengaluru within 30 days of receipt of Letter of Indent / Notification of Award.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration / Telephone Bill / Electricity Bill / Lease Agreement in the name of applicant.
Others -- Undertaking to open an office in Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be ISO 9001 certified relevant to scanning and digitization services.

Applicant should submit an Affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper, notarized, declaring the authenticity of documents, non-blacklisting confirmation, no pending legal disputes, not filed for bankruptcy, restrictions on public procurement from bidders of certain countries, compliance with RFP terms, and consequences of violation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Affidavit as per format enclosed in RFP. Should be on Rs. 100 stamp paper and notarized.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should submit a self-declaration Litigation Declaration Form on their letterhead with notarized.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Litigation Declaration Form as per format enclosed in RFP.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Expertise in the Subject Area Applicants experience in scanning and digitization services for Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding three (3) financial years (Should submit work order or purchase order or contract agreement) Each eligible project - 5 marks Maximum - 20 marks

Availability of High-speed Scanners Applicant should have high-speed scanners with auto digital datetime stamp, auto document classification/tagging, auto blank page removal (Should submit Make Model Auto Features Serial Number of Scanner Year of Purchase on Applicants letterhead duly signed and sealed) Each High-speed Scanner - 2.5 marks Maximum - 10 marks

Approach and Methodology Project planning, design and execution plan - 5 marks Prescanning, scanning and post scanning methodology - 5 marks Quality Control Process - 5 marks Timelines (Gantt chart) - 5 marks
Qualification and competence of the proposed staff for the Project Note Please refer RFP
Presentation Applicant shall give presentation as per the date and time intimated by the Client
Training Training Documentations and manuals - 5 marks Training Methodology - 5 marks
